name: us12-warn-allowlist
description: US12 allowlist without false positives (FR-053). The spec's content references an allowlisted Confluence host on *.atlassian.net — a coordinate the BLOCK tier (US11) would otherwise refuse with exit 9. With that host declared in the allowlist (SPEC_KIT_JIRA_ALLOWLIST), the pre-write guard neutralises it, so the create proceeds and reconcile exits 0. Both ports MUST emit a byte-identical run summary, an identical Jira API call sequence (the create POST is performed), and an identical post-run tree (NFR-1) — proving the allowlist suppresses the BLOCK false positive identically on both ports.
